'''2007 Worlds Day 1 Sean McGrath LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Sean McGrath]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Sean McGrath]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Plead My Case To The Senate]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
